rent.label: Residential rent agreement (India)
pages:
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
1. Term. This agreement is for 11 months commencing 1 April 2026, with a lock-in period of 6 months.
2. Rent. The monthly rent is Rs 28,000, payable in advance on or before the 5th day of each month.
3. Escalation. Rent shall increase by 8% on each renewal.
4. Security deposit. The tenant shall pay a refundable deposit of Rs 1,68,000.
5. Deductions. On vacating, one month's rent shall be deducted from the deposit towards painting and cleaning charges, irrespective of the condition of the premises.
6. Refund. The balance deposit shall be refunded within 45 days of handover of vacant possession.

7. Maintenance. Society maintenance charges shall be borne by the tenant in addition to rent.
8. Repairs. Minor repairs up to Rs 2,000 per instance are the tenant's responsibility; major structural repairs are the landlord's.
9. Entry. The landlord may enter the premises after 24 hours' written notice.
10. Notice. Either party may terminate after the lock-in by giving 2 months' written notice.
11. Subletting. The tenant shall not sublet or assign the premises.
12. Termination for default. The landlord may terminate immediately if rent is unpaid for 15 days.

offer.label: Software engineer offer letter
pages:
OFFER OF EMPLOYMENT
1. Position. Software Engineer II, reporting to the Engineering Manager, based at the Pune office.
2. Compensation. Annual fixed compensation of Rs 18,00,000, paid monthly.
3. Variable pay. A performance bonus of up to 10% of fixed pay may be paid at the sole discretion of the management, subject to company and individual performance.
4. Probation. You will be on probation for 6 months, during which either party may terminate with 15 days' notice.
5. Notice period. On confirmation, the notice period is 90 days.

6. Working hours. Standard hours are 9:30 am to 6:30 pm, Monday to Friday.
7. Leave. You are entitled to 18 days of paid leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays.
8. Confidentiality. You shall not disclose confidential information during or after employment.
9. Non-solicitation. For 12 months after exit you shall not solicit employees or clients of the company.
10. Governing law. This letter is governed by the laws of India, with courts at Pune having exclusive jurisdiction.

freelance.label: Freelance design contract
pages:
FREELANCE SERVICES AGREEMENT
1. Services. The contractor shall deliver brand identity design as described in Schedule A.
2. Fee. The total fee is Rs 2,40,000, invoiced in three equal milestones.
3. Payment terms. Invoices are payable within 60 days of receipt.
4. Revisions. The fee covers two rounds of revisions per milestone; further revisions are billed at Rs 3,000 per hour.
5. Intellectual property. All deliverables, including preparatory work, vest in the client on full payment.

6. Kill fee. If the client cancels after work has begun, the contractor is paid for the milestone in progress only.
7. Expenses. Pre-approved expenses are reimbursed at cost.
8. Independent contractor. The contractor is not an employee and is responsible for their own taxes.
9. Liability. The contractor's total liability is capped at the fees paid under this agreement.
10. Termination. Either party may terminate with 30 days' written notice.
